title: Product Manager,  Employee Experience & Productivity
description:
Imagine what you could do here. At Apple, great ideas have a way of becoming great products, services, and experiences very quickly. Apple's Employee Experience and Productivity team are seeking a Senior Product Manager who will be a crucial leader of a unique team responsible for defining, researching, and delivering Collaboration and Productivity tools to all business units at Apple. Some of the tools we deliver provide features to enhance large segments of our daily workflow; this includes tools built internally and sourced externally, and focus areas such as Meeting Experience, File Sync & Share, Chat, Content Collaboration, Work Management, and Artificial Intelligence.
Employee Experience and Productivity (EEP) is part of IS&T and delivers some of the most widely used communication and productivity technology and services across Apple — from tools that enable collaboration to the support teams that keep Apple's workforce running. EEP also leads user experience design and research, and manages the systems behind Apple's original content studios.
In this role, you will be leading the creation and management of tools to support and reshape how employees work together. As new business requirements evolve, you will craft the story, explore alternative solutions and define the vision, strategy, and roadmap for your portfolio of products. You should possess finely-tuned critical thinking skills and have significant breadth and depth as a best-in-class Product Manager. You will champion Apple's employee experience with collaboration tools, defining success through data-driven metrics and cross-functional collaboration to improve the current employee experience and envision innovative solutions that rival the excitement of a new Apple product. A key part of this role is the ongoing rationalization of your tool portfolio continuously evaluating the landscape to identify opportunities to consolidate redundant solutions, surface synergies across tools, and simplify the overall experience for employees, ensuring Apple's productivity ecosystem remains focused, cohesive, and eﬃcient.

4+ years of experience working cross-functionally with peer teams such as software engineering and UX Design.

title: Prototyping Systems Engineer - Platform Architecture
description:
Imagine what you could do here. At Apple, new ideas have a way of becoming extraordinary products, services, and customer experiences very quickly. Bring passion and dedication to your job, and there's no telling what we can accomplish together.
Our Platform Architecture group is responsible for connecting our hardware, software, and intelligence into one unified system, building core technologies that work across all disciplines. Join this team, and you’ll develop forward-looking prototype systems and experiences in collaboration with engineers and designers across Apple. We take daring, revolutionary ideas and turn them into reality. You and your team will apply engineering fundamentals, embrace emerging AI capabilities, and start from scratch if need be. Together, our work will lead to the intuitive technology experiences that Apple is known for worldwide.
The Platform Architecture systems prototyping team creates "livable prototypes": complete hardware and software product concepts that you can actually hold, interact with, and use in daily life, as opposed to isolated concept demonstrations. We are a small team of fearless, self-motivated, and curious generalists who love to make thoughtful, ambitious new things.
In this role, you will build end-to-end prototype systems from initial whiteboard sketches to working devices. Depending on the project, you might spend one week integrating custom sensors, edge compute modules, and real-time audio/video streams, and the next week wiring up local and cloud AI models or building an interactive user interface. Collaborating with hardware, silicon, software, and ML partners across Apple, you will combine technologies in new ways. Your curiosity will drive you to learn whatever you need to turn bold ideas into reality.

Experience designing and building software and computer systems

Experience interfacing software with hardware devices, sensors, or embedded platforms

title: RF Communications Systems Engineer
description:
At Apple, we strive every single day to craft products that enrich people’s lives. Our successes are the result of skilled domain experts working in an environment which encourages creativity, collaboration, and re-thinking of old problems in new ways! As a member of the Satellite Connectivity Group, you will work on the satellite network that enables connectivity to iPhone and Watch Ultra when off the grid without cellular or Wi-Fi coverage. Every day, Apple customers use Emergency SOS, Roadside assistance, and Messages via satellite to stay connected when they have no other means to communicate. You will have the unique and rewarding opportunity to shape this and other critical services, to the benefit and safety of millions of Apple device users.
Our team is seeking a RF communications systems engineer to build and improve space-based communications systems that touch people around the world. You will be working with an international, cross-functional team to deliver the future of high-performance, best-in-class wireless communications for millions of Apple customers. This includes everything from defining system architectures, to writing requirements and technical budgets, assessing system performance, planning test campaigns, and troubleshooting issues. You will be closely collaborating with internal teams as well as managing external suppliers to deliver on our vision. Help us build the next-generation Apple experience!
We’re looking for an engineer who will:
* Assess and trade performance of complex RF communications systems, breaking down contributions and interactions from subsystems and component units.
* Develop RF system budgets (link budgets, gain and noise figure cascades, interference analyses, etc.)
* Oversee and review RF system testing with internal teams and external suppliers.
* Lead anomaly root-cause investigations across development, test campaigns, and operational systems.
* Coordinate and drive alignment among cross-functional teams covering a diverse set of technical domains.
* Translate complex findings into simple, compelling narratives that motivate action and drive improvements.
* Travel regularly to collaborate closely with internal teams and external suppliers.
Minimum qualifications: 5+ years experience in RF or communications systems engineering or related experience.
BS in Engineering, Physics, Computer Science or related discipline.
Experience designing and deploying large scale RF communications infrastructure.
Strong knowledge of satellite RF communications systems.
Proficient at analyzing cascaded systems performance.
Proficient with link budgets and link quality assessments.
Excellent written & verbal communication skills, and solid teamwork & leadership skills.
Export Compliance Requirement: This position requires access to U.S. export-controlled technology and technical data regulated under the Export Administration Regulations (EAR). Applicants must be eligible to access this export-controlled information.
Preferred qualifications: 7+ years experience in space-based RF communications systems.
MS/PhD in Engineering, Physics, Computer Science or related discipline.
Fluent in satellite, ground-station, and end-to-end RF systems design.
Familiarity with phased array antenna and digital signal processing systems.
Experience deploying and testing space-based RF communications systems.
Experience with in-orbit operations.

title: RF Design Engineer – Next-Gen Wireless
description:
Join a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to deliver outstanding performance for wireless products. As a senior member of the Product RF Design team, you will be at the forefront of wireless technology, pushing the boundaries of achievable performance for innovative products. You'll bring deep, hands-on expertise to a product development team that shapes current and future generations of Apple products, and you'll play a key role in building team capability — guiding junior engineers, fostering collaboration, and strengthening the team's technical culture as it grows. We're looking for an experienced engineer with strong fundamentals and a proven track record in RF/wireless and electromagnetic theory, antenna design, system integration, and wireless communications.
As a mid/senior RF Design Engineer, you bring broad, deep knowledge across RF architecture, design, integration, and manufacturing. You have deep theoretical and practical expertise in electromagnetic theory, RF and wireless circuit design, communication theory, and product design trade-offs — and you know how to apply that expertise to resolve complex, ambiguous technical problems independently. You use electromagnetic and system simulation, hands-on prototyping, and test and measurement to understand complex system and sub-system interactions, their implications for product-level design, and manufacturing trade-offs that enable mass production at scale.

6+ years of experience in antenna/RF design in consumer products.
Demonstrated ownership of RF/antenna design through at least one full product cycle, from concept to mass production.
Strong foundation in antenna/RF design, wireless communications, EM theory, or circuit design.
Deep knowledge of EM or RF hardware and antenna design.
Preferred qualifications: Master's or above in Electrical Engineering with an Electro-magnetics or RF emphasis.
Advanced proficiency with electromagnetic simulation tools.
Extensive hands-on experience with RF lab instrumentation.
Proven ability to debug desense issues and characterize noise sources independently.
Experience driving production-environment problem solving and statistical analysis.
Experience mentoring or technically leading other engineers.

title: Retail Network Engineer, Infrastructure Services
description:
Do you want to help build some of the largest and most consequential enterprise and customer technology systems in the world? Join Apple’s Information Systems and Technology (IS&T) organization.
IS&T is the engine behind everything Apple does for customers and for the people who build for them. It’s Apple’s central nervous system. Supporting 2.5 billion active Apple devices, processing billions of secure transactions, and keeping the technology that defines modern life running flawlessly, IS&T makes the impossible feel effortless.”
Do you love building solutions to handle global complexity and immense scale? Imagine what you could do here.
Infrastructure Services is part of IS&T and the foundation of Apple's global network operations — managing data center equipment and systems to deliver compute, storage, and networking services for teams across Apple, including our Apple Retail Stores. From an individual store to a worldwide network, Infrastructure Services ensures the technology underneath everything works without question.
As a Retail Network Engineer, you will be part of a team focused on enabling experiences for Apple employees and our customers in Apple Stores all around the world. Our team works across Apple to ensure the network provides fast, reliable and secure connectivity powering critical functions such as point-of-sale, Genius Bar service, product demonstration, and more.
In this role you will take business and design requirements and turn them into fully featured network designs for Apple Retail stores. You will evaluate business needs, store design and layout, and network operational standards to develop a complete network solution. You will collaborate with business teams, real estate teams, design and development managers, project managers and network engineers across multiple disciplines to procure, deploy and configure the network.
A successful candidate will combine network expertise, troubleshooting skill, excellent judgment and strong communication of complex ideas to technical and leadership audiences.
The candidate will be responsible for growing and supporting Apple’s expanding retail network globally. They will need to excel in a fast-paced environment with the ability to multi-task and not only manage their own projects, but also be able to provide day to day operational support. This person must be a collaborative team player that will work across cross-functional groups and have the ability and willingness to learn new technologies, deepen expertise and have a sound business approach for supporting our global footprint.
We are looking for a Network Engineer to participate in projects and perform day to day support activities including, but not limited to:
Design network solutions to meet evolving business needs
Deploy WAN, wired LAN and Wi-Fi infrastructure for new and existing Retail Store locations
Diagnose and identify root causes of network issues
Build and maintain automation playbooks and scripts to support constant and scalable infrastructure deployment
Maintain consistency (software, configuration, security) across the global fleet
Schedule and execute change requests
Coordinate work with peers and vendors to deploy and troubleshoot infrastructure

BGP and Internet routing policy
Cisco IOS-XE, JUNOS, Arista EOS, FortiOS, Aruba AOS
Juniper SRX, Forinet Firewalls
Cisco Catalyst, Arista EOS switching platforms
SD-WAN, IPSEc VPN technologies
Cisco Catalyst, Aruba AOS Wi-Fi
Experience testing and provisioning of WAN circuits (Metro Ethernet, Dark Fiber, Transit)
Experience with standard linux utilities (grep, sed, awk, traceroute, tcpdump etc)

Bachelors in Computer Science, Network Engineering, Information Systems or a related field, or equivalent experience
Experience leveraging GenAI tools to improve capability or efficiency managing and deploying network infrastructure
Industry certifications such as CCNP, CCIE, CWNE, JNCIP are beneficial but not required
Strong written and oral communication skills

title: Senior / Staff ML Engineer, Training Services, Apple Cloud AI
description:
Apple is a place where extraordinary people gather to do their best work. Apple Cloud AI is the organization that builds Apple's central platform for developing machine learning and generative AI. Researchers, ML engineers, and software engineers across Apple rely on it to train, customize, evaluate, and optimize the models and AI agents behind their features. We provide these capabilities as secure, reliable, managed services on large-scale GPU and TPU infrastructure, so teams can move from an idea to a production-ready model quickly while meeting Apple's high bar for privacy.
Within Apple Cloud AI, our team owns model training services, from pre-training through post-training and distillation, for foundation, recommendation, embedding, speech, and vision models. We're looking for a Staff ML Engineer who understands model architectures and training algorithms from first principles and can translate that knowledge into better models from the same compute.
Minimum qualifications: 8+ years of software engineering or ML systems experience, including several years of hands-on distributed training on hundreds of accelerators or more.
Strong understanding of modern model architectures, especially transformers: model computation, memory requirements, and how architecture choices affect training cost.
Hands-on experience optimizing compute, memory, and communication in distributed training with PyTorch Distributed, Megatron-Core, JAX/XLA, or equivalent systems.
Strong programming skills in Python, plus C++, CUDA, Triton, or equivalent performance-oriented technologies.
Demonstrated ability to independently diagnose complex performance problems, implement optimizations, and validate improvements.
Proven record of leading technical work across teams and communicating complex tradeoffs clearly.
BS, MS, or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Preferred qualifications: Deep expertise in mixture-of-experts and expert parallelism, long-context models, or advanced attention mechanisms.
Experience developing high-performance kernels in CUDA, Triton, or Pallas, or optimizing execution through compilers such as XLA or torch.compile.
Experience with GPU and TPU architecture, distributed communication, and low-precision training such as FP8.
Significant contributions to open-source projects such as PyTorch, TorchTitan, Megatron-Core, DeepSpeed, JAX, OpenXLA, AXLearn, MaxText, Triton, FlashAttention, or Transformer Engine.
Experience designing training APIs or frameworks that other engineers build on, such as trainer abstractions, configuration systems, or low-level training primitives.

Experience training recommendation, multimodal, or diffusion models at scale.

title: Senior Computer Vision Architect
description:
The Video Computer Vision and Video Engineering teams are centralized applied research and engineering organizations responsible for developing real-time on-device Computer Vision, Machine Perception, and Image Quality technologies for Apple products. We balance research and product development to deliver Apple quality, state-of-the-art experiences. We innovate across the full stack and partner with hardware and software teams to influence SW architecture, sensors, silicon, and PD/ID roadmaps that bring our vision to life.
The Architecture team within our organization is responsible for bringing together computer vision algorithms, firmware, and low-level software teams to drive some of the most exciting programs across many Apple products! We do this by enabling the co-design of computer vision algorithms and systems through a deep understanding of the complexities and trade-offs between algorithm performance, imaging pipeline, system resources, and real-time constraints. To be successful in this role, you not only have to be an excellent engineer, but also a phenomenal collaborator—comfortable communicating with a wide range of experts and leaders across many different domains, from firmware and OS to feature and experience. Are you ready to be a part of the next big thing at Apple?
Minimum qualifications: BS degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, coupled with a minimum of 20 years of relevant, proven experience.
Proven track record of leading cross-functional initiatives that have successfully transformed state-of-the-art computer vision research into production-ready features.
Deep product mindset focused on architecting technical solutions that solve real business problems and deliver high customer value.
Deep understanding of multi-modal perception systems, sensor fusion, and diverse imaging technologies is crucial.
Depth of expertise in one or more computer vision specialty areas that this role assesses for. These areas may include SLAM, tracking, classification, calibration, PnP-based pose estimation, scene understanding, human representation, and image enhancement.
Strong leadership skills to drive large cross-functional efforts, resolve conflicts, and present results to the highest levels of Apple leadership. This includes demonstrating the ability to bridge the gap between high-level algorithm design and low-level system optimization, particularly in the challenging environment of optimizing image signal processing (ISP) performance under tight power and latency constraints.

Ideal candidates will have exposure to modern, innovative techniques such as vision transformers, foundation models, and vision-language models, with a strong focus on integrating these methods into resource-constrained environments.
Experience leading real-time computer vision projects (e.g., SLAM, tracking, classification, calibration, PnP-based pose estimation, scene understanding, human representation, and image enhancement) or low-level software development for ISP organizations.

title: Senior Data Governance Manager, Marcom
description:
Marcom is the creatively-led global team that oversees Apple’s consumer facing marketing. We ensure the flawless development and execution of world-class communications across all medias and platforms. Every day, hundreds of millions of Apple customers around the world interact with our products. We drive the strategy and creative work that provide both new and existing customers with simple, engaging and inspiring marketing experiences.
The Governance and Technology Operations (GTO) team safeguards Marcom’s people and work by building a strong governance framework and running the reliable technology and infrastructure the organization depends on. The team covers AI, tools, vendor, and data governance, along with Marcom Security and Marcom IT, and is building a Center of Excellence to centralize expertise, standardize practices, reduce risk, and keep improving how Marcom works. This role reports to the head of GTO and partners closely with IS&T, Procurement, and Security.
The Senior Data Governance Manager owns Marcom’s data governance strategy and infrastructure, making sure the data powering AI tools, models, and workflows is classified, protected, accessible to the right people, and reliable enough to drive decisions. This person charts the path to a centralized data lake where Marcom’s data is managed, cataloged, and governed in one place.
Minimum qualifications: 10+ years of experience in data governance, data architecture, data management, or a related discipline, including leadership of programs at scale.
Track record of building and operationalizing data governance frameworks, including data quality management, metadata management, and access control.
Experience defining data classification, lineage, and access control policies across complex organizations, including role-based, attribute-based, or equivalent models for data with tiered confidentiality.

description:

title: Sr. Software Engineer - Distributed Storage
description:
The Apple Services Engineering (ASE) team builds and provides systems that power many of Apple’s customer-facing services - including iCloud, iTunes, Siri and Maps. We deliver the core infrastructure primitives that enable teams across Apple to build services our customers rely on every day.
This is a ground-up effort to build a highly reliable, self-managing and scalable storage layer that can support exabyte-scale data and diverse access patterns. This new layer will also serve as the foundation for adopting and optimizing next-generation storage devices, enabling Apple to leverage emerging drive technologies with new performance and density characteristics. If you enjoy designing distributed systems that operate as a cohesive storage fabric, we want to hear from you.
We are creating a unified storage abstraction layer that will serve as the foundational layer for Apple’s distributed object, block, and future file storage systems. This new layer will provide a consistent API, common metadata model, scalable data distribution and high-performance IO path for workloads running in Apple Cloud.
Engineers on this team will work on the core of a unified storage layer designed to manage data objects, placement, redundancy and IO operations across thousands of nodes. You will help define the fundamental building blocks that unify different storage backends—object, block and future file interfaces—behind a single, extensible abstraction.
You will design consistent metadata services, build scalable data distribution algorithms, implement robust replication and fault-recovery mechanisms, and develop client-side libraries and protocols that expose a uniform interface to workloads across Apple.
Each component is being designed to support self-healing behaviors, automatic rebalancing and high-throughput, low-latency access paths.
We are looking for engineers who enjoy building foundational storage systems, solving complex distributed coordination challenges, and shaping a platform that will underpin Apple’s cloud storage strategy for many years.
Minimum qualifications: Strong problem-solving skills rooted in data structures, distributed systems, and concurrency.
7+ years of professional experience building and operating distributed systems.
Demonstrated ownership and history of delivering production systems.
Proficiency in one or more systems languages: Java, Rust, asynchronous and thread-safe programming.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
BS in Computer Science, or equivalent experience.

description:

title: US Industry and Ecosystem Lead, Life Sciences
description:
The people here at Apple don't just create products. They create the kind of wonder that's revolutionized entire industries. It's the diversity of those people and their ideas that inspires the innovation that runs through everything we do. Join Apple, and help us leave the world better than we found it!
Apple is looking for a US Industry and Ecosystem Lead to own our Life Sciences strategy across pharma and medical device, with the manufacturing floor as the beachhead, not the ceiling. Regulated production is where Apple can transform how life sciences companies work. From there, you scale across the full Apple platform, from Apple Watch and Health APIs to iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Vision Pro, and build the partner ecosystem that makes it repeatable.
Manufacturing is the frontier of this role. Pharma and medical device production runs on
paper, legacy terminals, and disconnected systems — one of the largest, least-served
openings for Apple anywhere. You will uncover and deliver on that opportunity: iPad and
iPhone on the GMP line, electronic batch records and device history records, paperless
quality and batch review, MES and manufacturing execution modernization, connected
frontline operators, and the data integrity and validation (21 CFR Part 11, GAMP 5) that
regulated production demands. You turn these into scaled, repeatable deployments
across the industry’s plants.
Increasingly, this means deploying on-device intelligence and AI-assisted workflows that
meet GxP validation standards — a frontier where Apple’s privacy architecture and on-
device ML create a defensible edge. GxP-validated AI and FDA’s evolving AI/ML
framework, alongside AI drug discovery, are the regulatory-adjacent shifts that will
define this role’s strategic agenda over the next three to five years.
To scale this across the industry, you grow the partner ecosystem in ways that drive
business — finding the pharma, biotech, medtech, CRO, and MES/quality-platform
partners that fit Apple’s growth strategy, building joint plans that deliver, and winning
executive buy-in for the big bets. You turn partnerships into repeatable, scalable wins.
You serve as Apple’s life sciences authority — reading trends early and translating
Pharma 4.0, GxP-validated AI, and regulatory shifts into strategic positions that move
partners and internal leaders to act.
Minimum qualifications: Approximately 15+ years at the intersection of technology and life sciences, in industry, consulting,
or a key ISV.
Direct experience with regulated manufacturing in pharma or medical device — GMP
plant floors, quality systems, and validated environments.
Proven track record building life sciences partner ecosystems and turning them into
scalable, repeatable business.
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.
Preferred qualifications: Deep manufacturing fluency: MES, electronic batch records, device history records,
paperless quality, and connected-worker platforms.
Ability to read trends early — smart manufacturing / Pharma 4.0, AI drug discovery,
digital biomarkers, cell and gene therapy — and position ahead of them.
Fluency with FDA 21 CFR Part 11, GAMP 5, GxP, Software as a Medical Device
(SaMD), 510(k), HIPAA, and UDI.
Established network among senior manufacturing, quality, technology, and
regulatory leaders in US life sciences.
Exceptional executive communication; a compelling storyteller who moves partners
and leaders to act.
Advanced degree in a life sciences, engineering, regulatory, or business discipline.

title: US-Lead Genius
description:
Apple Retail is where the best of Apple comes together. We bring our expertise to help people do what they love, delivering an only-at-Apple experience. You play a critical role in facilitating meaningful experiences for both customers and team members, and inform and energize our teams to do their best work and contribute to operational excellence. Have experience troubleshooting hardware and software issues in a customer service environment.
Have experience mentoring or leading others personally or professionally.

Demonstrate technical expertise in repairing Apple devices.
Motivate others to achieve performance goals by fostering open dialog, collaboration, and recognition.
Resolve conflict and settle differences in productive ways.

title: iPad & Input Product Design Engineering Program Manager
description:
Looking for a Product Design Engineering Program Manager to own and drive new product development in the Input and iPad System team. Be responsible for the technical management of the development and implementation process for the mechanical components of one of our Input Devices or iPad product development teams. In this role you will drive the day-to-day activities to meet the overall program objectives focusing on engineering, development planning and validation cycles. This involves engaging with large cross functional teams to balance several competing objectives and meet aggressive deliverable timelines.
This Input and iPad PD EPM will work closely with cross functional Engineering teams who are focused on the development of the key technologies that enable next generation iPad and Input accessories such as Pencil and keyboards. This means you are someone capable of quickly gaining understanding of program and cross functional needs and keeping up with their dynamic nature.

Self motivated and proactive with demonstrated creative and critical thinking capabilities

title: iPhone Hardware System Design Electrical Engineer
description:
Imagine the world without Apple devices! Does it feel strange?
Apple products might even be one of the reasons you wanted to BE a Hardware Design Engineer. Now, imagine yourself designing future Apple products.
Designing hardware for iPhone means learning how to build high-performance electronics where every cubic millimeter matters. It is a masterclass in modern hardware engineering—blending high-speed digital buses, ultra-low-noise power rails, and flexible circuits into an integrated system built at unprecedented quality and scale.
The iPhone Hardware System Design team is looking for a driven Electrical Engineer who is passionate about circuit design, board-level bring-up, and hands-on problem solving. You will own the design, validation, and integration of critical rigid-board and flexible-circuit modules, working side-by-side with world-class engineers. If you are eager to dive deep into schematics, spend time in the lab probing waveforms, and see your designs ship in products used by millions, join us.
In this role, you will be an active contributor to the hardware design and validation cycle of future iPhone hardware:
Circuit Design & Integration: Own schematics, component selection and collaborate closely with CAD layout engineers for dedicated rigid boards, flexible printed circuits (FPCs), and system interconnect modules.
Hands-On Lab Bring-Up: Lead the first-time power-on and functional bring-up of your hardware blocks in the lab; debug hardware bugs down to component level using high-speed scopes and digital analyzers.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner daily with mechanical engineering (Product Design), firmware, thermal, silicon, and factory teams to ensure smooth mechanical and electrical integration.
There will be opportunities for international travel.
Minimum qualifications: BS or MS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or equivalent.
2+ years of experience in board-level electrical hardware design and verification.
Strong grasp of core EE fundamentals: circuit theory, analog fundamentals, digital logic, and basic power regulation.
Demonstrated hands-on lab experience bringing up and debugging prototype hardware.
Preferred qualifications: High speed digital design
Schematic capture and PCB layout
Hands-on lab experience with hardware bring-up and debug
Fundamentals of signal and power integrity
Understanding of low voltage power regulation solutions
Integration of hardware into multi-functional systems
Use of scripting languages to assist with hardware development
Familiarity with the challenges of taking a product from design through to production
Excellent Verbal, written and presentation skills
Experience working with dynamic multi-functional teams
Automation: Proficiency with tools to enable automation (AI usage to develop tools and for other efficiency improvements is a plus)

description:
At Apple, people don't just build products. They build the kind of wonder that has reshaped entire industries. title: Deployment Engineer (Field Operations)
description:
ABOUT BASE

Base is America’s next-generation power company. We’re rebuilding the foundation of modern civilization–electricity–by deploying a vast network of distributed batteries that is transforming today’s fragile, centralized grid into a resilient and abundant system. We are engineers, operators, and creatives solving some of the most complex, interdisciplinary challenges of our time.




ABOUT THE ROLE

As our Deployment Engineer, you are the technical expert and central lifeline for our field crews. You are the voice of Base from mission control, providing end-to-end guidance to ensure every battery installation and service call is safe, efficient, and successful. This is not a typical support role. You’ll be the interdisciplinary link between our field electricians, our engineers, and our members, using tools like Grafana and Retool to monitor system health while troubleshooting issues over the phone, text, and Slack. This role offers a unique opportunity to develop a 360-degree view of our technology. 



You’ll gain real-world expertise in hardware, software, and field operations, all while contributing directly to the improvement of our product and deployment playbooks. This role is best suited for a tech-savvy experienced engineer who enjoys solving complex problems in real-time or for a fast-learning generalist that can flex into any scope and excel. Over time, this position could grow into potential field leadership, operations, or engineering roles.



What You'll Do

 - Typical week: ~75% of your time live-supporting (from our HQ in Austin, TX) field crews during installations and service calls; ~25% analyzing issues, updating playbooks, and collaborating with other teams.

 - Provide end-to-end guidance and troubleshooting for battery installations and service calls over phone, text, and Slack.

 - Serve as the first line of technical support for in-field electrical questions and hardware issues, escalating complex compliance issues and documenting new solutions.

 - Identify field issue trends over time and flag high impact issues to hardware, software, or deployment teams.

 - Work closely with Member Experience to ensure the best possible experience for our members.

 - Create and maintain troubleshooting aid and hardware defect logs.

 - Create, track, and close service tickets through Jira or Odoo.

 - You’ll directly impact installation speed, safety, and uptime while your insights will shape our hardware roadmap and operating procedures.
   
   

What You'll Bring

 - 2+ years in a technical support, electrical, or IT troubleshooting role.

 - Strong foundation in electrical concepts; licensed electrician or hands-on field experience is a plus but not required.

 - Proven ability to quickly learn complex technical systems (electrical code, hardware, and software tools).

 - 4-year degree or equivalent electrical experience.

 - Strong communication and organization skills – bilingual is a plus but not required.

 - Ability to multitask, remain calm under pressure, de-escalate high pressure situations, be decisive, and practice patience.

 - Desire and ability to think analytically and creatively to resolve complex issues and suggest process improvements.

 - Attention to detail in communicating accurately and clearly, tracking field interactions, and documenting solutions.

 - Comfortable with ambiguity and a fast-paced environment to quickly adapt to changes while maintaining high-quality support.

 - Tech savvy, with a knack for quickly mastering new tools and systems.

 - Team player motivated by the mission who always puts the company’s best interests first.



About the Team

Deployment Engineering is Base Power’s mission control for field operations, acting as the real-time support system for our installation crews. This team sits at the intersection of field electricians, engineering, and member experience, ensuring every install and service call runs smoothly, safely, and efficiently.

Beyond live troubleshooting, the team plays a key role in identifying trends, improving deployment playbooks, and influencing product and operational decisions. Their work directly impacts installation speed, system uptime, and the overall member experience—making them a critical driver of our growth.

This is a team built for people who enjoy fast-paced problem solving, cross-functional collaboration, and developing a full-stack understanding of hardware, software, and field operations.



Please note: Base is a startup, which means priorities shift and evolve quickly. Your role may expand or change based on the needs of the business at any given time, so the responsibilities listed may not be exhaustive.




OUR VALUES

 - First Principles Thinking: Question assumptions. Principles > rules.

 - Operate at Base Pace: Focus on what matters, act quickly, and learn by doing.

 - Give & Get Feedback: Be direct, be humble, and maintain a growth mindset.

 - Everyone’s an Owner: Follow through on commitments and own results.

 - Strong Opinions, Loosely Held: Drive clarity and make calls with imperfect information.

 - Committed to the Mission: Rebuilding the grid is a big challenge. We work hard because we care deeply about the impact we’re creating. We work in-person. It’s not a 9-to-5. We are all-in.

 - Fun & Optimism Coexist with Grit: Collaboration and celebration coincide with the intensity of building real things.
   
   


DO THE BEST WORK OF YOUR LIFE AT BASE.

title: Senior Accounting Manager
description:
ABOUT BROCCOLI AI

At Broccoli, we're building AI teammates for the people who build and maintain our world.

We partner with plumbing, HVAC, and electrical contractors, the hardworking businesses that keep homes and communities running, and replace fragmented software and repetitive manual work with AI that actually gets the job done.

Our AI teammates answer phones, book appointments, follow up with customers, recover missed revenue, and help contractors deliver exceptional customer experiences, all while integrating seamlessly with platforms like ServiceTitan.

Before we wrote a single line of code, we visited more than 140 contractors to understand how these businesses truly operate. That firsthand experience shaped everything we've built.

Today:

 - Hundreds of contractors rely on Broccoli every day.

 - We've grown to $25M+ ARR in under two years.

 - We're trusted by everyone from independent contractors to some of the largest private equity backed operators in the home services industry.

 - We're backed by Khosla Ventures and Y Combinator.

We're still just getting started.



THE ROLE

We're hiring a Senior Accounting Manager, our first in-house accountant, to own Broccoli's accounting, payroll, and tax end to end. You'll run the close, own revenue accounting for a fast-growing, usage-based business, keep us compliant in every state we operate in, and build the controls and systems that get us audit ready.

This is a deeply hands-on role reporting to our Head of Finance. You'll do the work yourself, make the accounting calls and document them, and work with our external accountant and outside tax advisors. You'll partner with Sales, Customer Success, People and Engineering. There's real building to do: a faster close, cleaner revenue data, tighter controls, and an AI-native finance stack where automation carries the repetitive work.



WHERE WE ARE TODAY

We run on QuickBooks Online, with Measure on top of Stripe for billing, Rippling for payroll and HR, and Brex for cards, bill pay and reimbursements. Revenue mixes subscription fees with usage-based billing, across customers from single-location contractors to multi-site enterprise operators. We have a US company and a subsidiary in India, and an external accountant who handles day-to-day transactions today and will work with you.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own the close and the financial statements. Run the close calendar, journal entries, accruals and reconciliations across bank, card, Stripe and payroll. Deliver accurate monthly financials and flux analysis on a business-day-10 timeline, then make it faster.

 - Own revenue accounting and billing. Set and document our ASC 606 policies for subscription, usage-based and multi-location enterprise contracts. Own the billing system (Measure, on Stripe), its sync to the GL, usage accruals and true-ups, and invoice adjustments.

 - Own AR and AP. Run collections, reserves and write-off policy across a customer base that runs from single-location contractors to large multi-site operators. Own vendor setup, bank-detail verification, bill pay, and card and reimbursement policy in Brex against a defined approval matrix, with real segregation of duties.

 - Own payroll. Run payroll in Rippling end to end, including new hires, terminations, pay changes, benefits deductions and off-cycle payments, and reconcile every run to the GL. Own multi-state payroll tax: registrations as we hire in new states, withholding, unemployment insurance, filings, and year-end W-2s and 1099s.

 - Own tax. Stand up sales tax: run the nexus analysis, register where we need to, then set up and enable tax calculation in our billing system and own the filings. Manage income and franchise tax with our outside advisors, plus 1099s and state annual filings.

 - Run treasury operations. Execute bank and card operations, wires and cash movements within approved limits, and keep cash reconciled across our accounts.

 - Get us audit ready. Build the policies, controls and schedules (revenue, equity compensation under ASC 718, prepaids and accruals) that make a first audit and investor diligence straightforward.

 - Support planning and reporting. Deliver clean, on-time actuals for budgeting and for board and investor reporting.

 - Run the international side. Own accounting, statutory compliance and intercompany funding for our India subsidiary, working with local providers.

 - Automate the work. Help choose and implement our next-generation GL, and build the automation that lets a small team run a growing company's books, so AI does the work rather than just reporting on it.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 7–10 years of accounting experience, including time in-house at a venture-backed startup.

 - CPA license.

 - Big 4 or comparable public accounting experience, ideally with technology clients.

 - You've owned a monthly close and the financial statements end to end, and you've made and documented the accounting calls behind them.

 - Strong command of US GAAP, including ASC 606.

 - You've run payroll yourself, or you're ready to own it hands-on from day one.

 - You like doing the work. You're as comfortable fixing a reconciliation yourself as designing the process that prevents the next one.

 - You use AI tools in your accounting work today and have a view on where they help.

 - Excellent written communication, with the judgment to explain an accounting call to non-finance partners and to know which calls need escalating.

 - Excited to work in person five days a week with the team in San Francisco.

 - Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance or a related field.



BONUS POINTS

 - Usage-based or hybrid SaaS revenue under ASC 606.

 - You've run payroll in Rippling, including multi-state employees and off-cycle payments.

 - QuickBooks Online, Brex, and a subscription billing platform (Measure, Maxio, Chargebee, Stripe Billing or similar), including getting its data to tie to the GL.

 - You've taken a company through its first financial statement audit or a fundraising diligence process.

 - You've set up sales tax or multi-state payroll tax compliance from scratch.

 - You've migrated a company onto an AI-native accounting platform (Rillet, Campfire or similar).

 - Multi-entity or international subsidiary accounting, ideally India.

 - Commission accounting (ASC 340-40) or sales comp administration.

 - SQL or comfort pulling your own data.

 - Experience in home services or B2B SaaS selling to SMBs.



THIS ROLE MIGHT NOT BE FOR YOU IF

 - You want to build and manage a team in your first year. You may be our only in-house accountant for a while.

 - You'd rather review work than do it.

 - You're looking for a remote or hybrid role.

Reporting to the Director of Cyber Detection Engineering, you’ll build, tune, and maintain enterprise- and customer-focused detection capabilities, including AI-assisted detection workflows and automation, with guidance and support from senior engineers on the team. You’ll work closely with Incident Response, Threat Intelligence, and Vulnerability Management to strengthen detection coverage. The ideal candidate has solid hands-on experience with SIEM log analysis gained in detection engineering or a SOC, a working knowledge of Incident Response and Threat Intelligence, and uses AI tools daily to work faster and smarter. Strong verbal and written communication skills and a drive to keep learning are essential.
What You’ll Do
Cybersecurity Detection Engineering:
Build, test, and maintain detections that protect Cox Automotive’s internal systems as well as its domestic and international businesses.
Contribute to the Detection Engineering roadmap and objectives by delivering assigned work and recommending improvements to senior engineers.
Use AI tools and large language models daily to accelerate detection development, query writing, log analysis, investigation, and documentation, and validate AI output for accuracy before use.
Build and maintain AI-assisted detection and triage workflows (such as prompts, agent steps, and automated enrichment) as part of detection solutions, following established patterns and guidance from senior engineers.
Develop and tune detection rules, automated remediation playbooks, and alerts using SIEM, EDR, and SOAR platforms, tailored to Cox Automotive’s enterprise and customer threat landscape.
Use the MITRE ATT&CK and ATLAS frameworks to map detections, assess coverage, and help identify gaps.
Monitor detection performance and tune detections to reduce false positives and improve effectiveness.
Collaborate with the Threat Detection and Response team to continuously improve the identification and response to threats.
Perform attack simulation testing to validate the efficacy of detection use cases, using established tools and procedures.
Support purple teaming exercises in collaboration with the Vulnerability Management team.
Support SIEM/Data Lake log ingestion by onboarding log sources, validating parsing and data quality, and troubleshooting ingestion issues, in collaboration with Cyber Defense Engineering counterparts.
Evaluate, validate, tune, and recommend retirement of detections as needed.
Collect and report detection metrics, such as alert volume, false positive rates, and coverage, on a routine basis.
Build and maintain operational guidelines, diagrams, and documentation for security detection and response.
Participate in an off-hours support rotation for security detection and response activities.
Incident Response:
Collaborate with the Incident Response team to support rapid detection and containment of cyber threats.
Build threat detection logic during incident response, with guidance, to accelerate threat identification and containment.
Contribute to improving detection and response processes based on lessons learned from incidents.

Apply threat intelligence from the Threat Intelligence team to build and enhance detections.
Research new and emerging threats and share findings with the team to inform detection priorities.
Stakeholder Collaboration:
Partner with other Cybersecurity, Engineering, and Product teams to support successful deployment of detection and response solutions.
Support Product teams in implementing customer-focused detection and response solutions, with guidance from senior engineers.
Communicate detection capabilities and findings clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders and escalate issues to senior engineers or leadership as needed.
Governance and Compliance:
Follow detection and response processes that adhere to regulatory requirements and industry standards (e.g., GDPR, PCI-DSS, NIST).
Maintain documentation of detection use cases, processes, and configurations.

1+ year of experience in Detection Engineering or in a Security Operations Center (SOC) role. Direct Detection Engineering experience is not required for candidates with SOC experience.

Working knowledge of information security, network security, security monitoring, and Incident Response fundamentals.
Demonstrated daily use of AI tools and prompt engineering to support security or technical work.

Ability to work independently on defined tasks and to seek guidance when needed.

Experience with AI/ML frameworks or building AI-assisted workflows for security applications.

Cox Fleet keeps your fleet moving!
Headquartered in Indianapolis, Cox Fleet has grown to become one of the largest fleet maintenance companies in the country.
Cox Fleet is the leading provider of on-site mobile maintenance and repair services nationwide, offering mobile on-site fleet service for light medium, and heavy-duty trucks and trailers. Cox Fleet also services customers utilizing its 50+ nationwide service centers; each offering accident repair, painting, refurbishment, and heavy mechanical repair. Cox Fleet is currently hiring a Mobile Diesel Technician II.
The Mobile Diesel Technician II will be responsible for performing licensed DOT inspections, Preventative Maintenance inspections, light and advanced repairs, advanced mechanical/hydraulic/electrical and electronic diagnostics, and other duties as assigned.   Heavily relied upon for advanced diagnostics and triage of complicated repairs by Mobile Diesel Technician I/II.  Considered the Lead on jobsites by customers and Technicians.  Functions as a consultant on the customer's behalf.  A successful Mobile Diesel Technician II complies with all company policies and achieves high level performance metrics.
DUTIES:
Perform scheduled preventative maintenance (“PM”), DOT Inspections and follow up repairs on light, medium and heavy-duty vehicles in a mobile/field environment.
Perform minor adjustment and repairs on various types of truck equipment including, but not limited to the following: Electrical/Brake/Cooling Systems, Starters/Alternators, Fan clutches, Engine electronics, Diesel steering systems, Engines (gas and diesel), Transmissions (manual and automatic), Clutches, Differentials, etc.
Diagnose, adjust, and repair various types of truck equipment including, but not limited to the following: Electrical/Brake/Cooling Systems, Starters/Alternators, Air conditioning systems, Fan clutches, Engine electronics, Diesel steering systems, Engines (gas and diesel), Transmissions (manual and automatic), Clutches, Differentials, etc.
Inspect, test, and listen to defective equipment to diagnose malfunctions, using test instruments such as handheld computers and pressure gauges.
Road test vehicles to diagnose malfunctions and to ensure that they are working properly.
Identify problems, determine accuracy and relevance of information, using sound judgment to generate and evaluate alternatives.
Independently manage parts inventory and equipment provided on company-issued service truck and perform periodic reconciliation.
Maintain and operate company-issued service vehicle, conduct safety checks, and pre-/post-trip inspections of vehicle.
Work with and listen effectively to clients and customers to assess their needs, providing information or assistance, resolving their problems, or satisfying their expectations.
Manage concurrent assigned tasks, making effective judgments as to prioritizing work related activities and time allocations.
Use hand tools, precision instruments, as well as Diesel tools, welding equipment, lift and jacks.
Document according to company standards and upload pictures of work performed, parts used, and all findings observed on Repair Orders (“RO”) using company-issued iOS device and our proprietary TRAIT application.
Accurately complete DOT forms and all other forms of documentation in timely fashion.
Work with a high degree of independence and manage own daily schedule.
Maintain a high level of productivity and be able to work within or close to most Standard Repair Times.
Obtain parts from approved local and national vendors as necessary for the repairs to be performed.
Communicate with management and support team via email or phone to obtain approvals on repair estimates, retrieve purchase order numbers and/or discuss RO findings notes.
Perform all work in compliance with organizational safety, health and environmental policies, and federal regulations, to include OSHA, EPA, and DOT.
Maintain company issued service truck, conduct safety checks and daily pre/post trip inspections.

description:
About the Team
DoorDash Labs is an independent team within DoorDash. We explore robotics and automation to transform last-mile logistics in the long term. If you have a passion for applying robotics solutions in a service used by millions of people, then we want to talk to you!
About the Role
The Simulation team builds software, models, and environments to test on-road autonomous robot behavior and evaluate autonomy changes before deployment. We are hiring an Autonomy Simulation Engineer to improve simulation fidelity and accelerate the development and validation of autonomous delivery robots.
You will develop production simulation software and models of robot behavior and interactions with the environment, using real-world data and repeatable experiments to calibrate and validate them. Working closely with autonomy and robotics engineers, you will own projects from design through validation and report to the Simulation Lead. We expect this role to be hybrid, with some time in-office and some time remote.
You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…
Develop and maintain the simulation engine and supporting software.
Build and improve simulation models of robot behavior, other participants, and their interactions.
Calibrate and validate simulation models against real-world behavior using controlled, repeatable experiments.
Develop parameterized environments and synthetic scenarios to test conditions and interactions that are difficult to capture in the field.
Investigate differences between simulated and real-world behavior, identify contributing model assumptions and parameters, and implement improvements.
Improve simulator reproducibility, reliability, usability, and debuggability.
We’re excited about you because…
You have strong production C++ and Python experience.
You can translate real-world behavior and physical systems into practical software models.
You have experience building closed-loop or interactive simulation software, with depth in areas such as robot dynamics, physics, road-user behavior, synthetic scenario generation, or probabilistic modeling.
You have used real-world data and controlled, repeatable experiments to test, calibrate, or validate software models.
You have experience debugging complex systems and delivering reliable production software using Linux, Git, automated testing, and CI.
Experience applying machine learning to simulation modeling and validating learned models against real-world data is a plus.

DashMart is a local-fulfillment center owned and operated by DoorDash, offering customers household essentials and other items to their doorsteps with speed, reliability, and quality. Customers order their convenience, grocery, retail, and prepared foods in the DoorDash app, and our team members fulfill orders in a real, brick-and-mortar store for Dashers to deliver. DashMart is looking for a motivated and experienced individual that excels in fast-paced, physical environments and is excited to roll up their sleeves and actively engage in day-to-day operations.  In this role, you will work within a local fulfillment center supporting Site Management running great shifts, and delegating tasks. As a Shift Lead, you will have shift responsibility for fulfilling orders in a warehouse environment and maintaining inventory, and in some locations, this involves preparing food in a light-prep kitchen.
You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…
Be an Owner: Take ownership of your assigned shifts, including warehouse and kitchen processes, safety/cleanliness, quality, and training. Maintain accountability for inventory, equipment, and other company assets to ensure they are properly handled, stored, and protected from loss or theft.
Delight Customers: Ensure customer orders are delivered with high quality by executing orders accurately, communicating with customers when issues arise, and making sure Dasher pickups go smoothly.
Lead: Guide Operations Associates through their shift by ensuring the team works safely and productively and serving as the point of escalation for daily operations.
One Team One Fight: Support operations in both the warehouse and kitchen, assist with day-to-day tasks, and lead by example. You will be expected to engage in professional and respectful interactions with team members and customers, ensuring a positive and safe atmosphere in the warehouse while providing a high-quality experience for our customers.
Help improve operations: Contribute ideas to improve our quality and customer experience.

description:
About the Team
Our sales and success teams are the heart and soul of DoorDash, helping us partner with top merchants (think restaurants, grocers, convenience stores, retailers) across the country to grow their revenue and help them operate even better. As DoorDash grows both in scale and scope of offering, the strength of our sales engine and organizational structure must grow with it.
About the role
We are looking for a Manager in Sales Strategy and Operations to be the strategic and operational partner to our SMB Business Development (BD) team as it expands its remit and increases restaurant coverage. You will own the operating foundation for BD’s merchant sales motion, including goal setting, pipeline management, lead allocation, and performance reporting.
In this role, you will make sure we are  Making efficient, data-driven decisions,
Building scalable operating systems for a growing sales motion,
Using and advocating for AI tooling, and
Centralizing the metrics that drive sales performance. You’ll work with our Sales, Selection, Operations, Product, Finance, and Analytics teams to build and scale that foundation, helping BD win new restaurant partners and grow those partnerships.
You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…
Build from first principles. BD's sales motion is evolving to capture top restaurants in priority markets, and this role will design how it runs: goal structures, input and activity metrics, pipeline stages, and rules of engagement with adjacent sales teams. You'll question "this is how it's always been done" and build what the team needs next.
Drive operational excellence. You'll set up and run reporting cadences, rigorous pipeline reviews, and productivity inspection with sales leaders, taking each one end to end from idea to execution and grounding decisions in data.
Own lead strategy and GTM targeting. You’ll partner with our GM teams to point BD reps at the highest-value opportunities, with clear ownership across teams.
Operate at 10,000 feet and 1 foot. One day you'll size goals and model capacity for a growing team. The next you'll be in diagnosing and improving data fidelity or tracing a pacing gap to its root cause.
Look around corners with AI. You'll find where AI tooling can remove manual work from sales operations and reporting, then build and scale those solutions, helping the team become more efficient as it grows.
We’re excited about you because…
You have 6+ years of experience in sales strategy and operations, revenue operations, consulting, business development, analytics, or related fields, with a track record of leading initiatives and hitting goals

You are an owner with a strong bias for action, comfortable with ambiguity, and willing to roll up your sleeves and flex up or down as needed
You have a Bachelor's degree or higher
Why You'll Love Working at DoorDash…
We are leaders – Leadership is not limited to our management team. It's something everyone at DoorDash embraces and embodies.
We are operators – We believe the only way to predict the future is to build it. Creating solutions to lead our company and our industry is what we do on every project, every day.
We are learners – Everyone here is continually learning on the job, no matter if we've been in a role for one year or one minute. We are committed to learning and implementing what is best for our customers, merchants, and dashers.
We are one team – The magic of DoorDash is our people, together making our inspiring goals attainable and driving us to greater heights.

location: San Francisco, CA; New York, NY; Seattle, WA
description:
About the Team
At DoorDash, design means making experiences for the people who order, the people who prepare, and the people who deliver. As a Designer at DoorDash, you want to build things that matter to real people. You're at your best when you can move from idea to shipped product quickly, bringing experiences to life that reach and influence users at massive scale. You'll care about whether the product you make solved a real problem for real people, or changed how someone experiences their day.
You'll work shoulder-to-shoulder with Engineering and Product Management, dig into the data, and use LLM-powered tools alongside traditional design tools. If the LLM powered tools don’t exist yet, you build them.
About the Role
Restaurants are the heart of every neighborhood, yet most run on a patchwork of disconnected tools. We’re building DashOS, the operating system for the restaurant of the future. It’s one platform that connects delivery, in-store dining, reservations, and loyalty, across software, kiosk and POS hardware, and agentic experiences that take work off operators’ plates.
As Principal Visual Designer, you’ll set the look, feel, and identity of DoorDash’s merchant products. You’ll own the visual direction for DashOS and give merchants a recognizable identity across every surface, including hardware, where no design conventions exist yet. These products already work. Your job is to make merchants love using them.
Visual craft is the center of this role, and you’ll ship it yourself. You’ll prototype and use AI tools like Cursor and Claude to generate and refine UI, so your ideas reach production with full fidelity. You’ll also define the visual foundation of the design system (tokens, components, guidance, and examples) so designers, engineers, and AI tools all produce on-brand, high-quality UI. Engineering partners build and maintain the tooling, and you set the rules and the quality bar.
You’ll report to the Senior Director, Product Design for Merchant. This role is hybrid, with 1–2 days a week in a Design Hub.
You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…
Set the visual direction for merchant products across DashOS and bring multiple teams around a shared vision, so the work compounds instead of duplicating.
Ship high-craft interfaces with a clear point of view , turning complex, data-dense workflows into screens merchants can read at a glance in a busy kitchen or at the counter.
Own the visual foundation of the design system : define the tokens, components, usage rules and examples that both people and AI tools apply. Review generated UI against that bar, record what good looks like, and improve the system based on how teams actually use it.
Design for new surfaces. Create visual systems for points-of-sale, handhelds and agentic experiences where no existing paradigm applies.
Influence through the work. Earn trust with prototypes and shipped products instead of decks, and keep your prototypes production-ready.
Raise the bar across the team. Mentor senior designers, help close strong hires, and help people sharpen their sense of what to build and why.
We’re excited about you because…
You’ve designed interfaces that defined or reshaped a product’s look and feel, and your portfolio shows top-of-bar visual craft with range across brands and styles.
You can build what you design. You work in React, TypeScript or similar, and use AI tools to explore directions and refine UI faster than you could by hand.
You’ve set direction across a product area, and people adopted your work because it was good, not because you told them to.
You’d rather build a visual system that makes 20 designers faster and more consistent than ship one great screen yourself.
You’ve worked on complex, information-dense products such as point-of-sale, fintech, marketplaces or platform teams, and you’ve shipped with product and engineering partners, including pushing back constructively.
Bonus: you’ve designed for devices or contexts with no existing design paradigm and built the visual system from scratch.

About the Team
The Paid Marketing Analytics team is looking for an experienced Senior Data Scientist to lead brand analytics at DoorDash. This Data Scientist will partner closely with senior Marketing leaders to define our brand measurement approach and guide our brand investment strategy and decision-making. Data Scientists at DoorDash work to uncover insights and turn them into relevant recommendations, driving decisions for the entire organization. Analytics is integral to all operational areas at DoorDash.
About the Role
As a Senior Data Scientist leading brand analytics, you’ll use your quantitative background in brand analytics to define how we measure the impact of brand investment and how brand health affects our business. You’ll report to the leader of Marketing Analytics, and partner closely with our Brand Marketing team. If you enjoy finding patterns amidst chaos, and have experience using brand analytics to affect revenue, growth, and investment, we're looking for someone like you!
You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…
Influence brand strategy, define brand measurement for DoorDash, and play a crucial role in sharing the DoorDash brand externally with our customers.
Partner closely with Marketing leadership to define metrics, KPIs, and a measurement strategy for the DoorDash brand
Work at the intersection of modeling, brand strategy, and business decision making
Use quantitative analysis and the presentation of data to see beyond the numbers and understand what drives our business
Use brand lift survey data, internal metrics, and incrementality testing to create a holistic view of brand impact
Build full-cycle analytics experiments, reports, and dashboards using cutting-edge AI tooling, SQL, R, Python, or other scripting and statistical tools
Be a champion of Brand Analytics within the team and advocate and educate on broader incorporation of leading concepts into Marketing and Consumer plans
Produce recommendations and use statistical techniques and hypothesis testing or causal inference to validate your findings
Provide insights to help business and product leaders understand marketplace dynamics, user behaviors, and long-term trends

Work backwards from understanding and sizing problems to ideating solutions

A degree in Math, Physics, Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, or a similar domain
5+ years of experience in brand and marketing analytics owning brand measurement at the intersection of modeling, brand strategy, and business decision making
Demonstrated experience leading the design, implementation, and ongoing operation of an end-to-end brand measurement system, including KPI selection and validation, ongoing brand tracking, campaign lift measurement, and integration with MMM and incrementality testing.
Experience leading brand modeling, working directly with clients, and translating the findings into decisions that drive business growth.
Deep understanding of brand marketing and paid media, with a track record of translating measurement findings into decisions about audiences, investment, and channel mix, and evaluating the relationship between brand health and downstream business outcomes.
Understanding of brand health metrics, consumer attitudes, audience strategy, creative effectiveness, and how media channels contribute across the funnel
Experience with marketing and brand measurement, MMM, attribution, incrementality testing, and brand lift surveys
Expertise of SQL queries, ETL, A/B Testing, Causal Inference, survey analytics, and statistical analysis (e.g. hypothesis testing, experimentation, regressions) with statistical packages, such as Matlab, R, SAS or Python
Experience leveraging AI coding tools to improve productivity and harden repeatable processes without sacrificing accuracy or code quality (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor)
The insight to take ambiguous problems and solve them in a structured, hypothesis-driven, data-supported way

description:
About the Team
DoorDash’s ML Serving Platform delivers tens of millions of predictions per second across DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo, powering search, recommendations, advertising, and logistics. We build request routing, online feature retrieval, and CPU/GPU inference capabilities that help ML and product teams deploy and operate models independently.
About the Role
We’re looking for a hands-on senior engineer to lead core serving investments. We’re especially interested in engineers who have scaled ranking and recommendation systems in production. You’ll make architectural decisions, write production code, and guide delivery with ML, product, and compute infrastructure partners.
Your first 6–12 months will focus on enabling new ranking and recommendation models, including generative approaches, in online production. You’ll resolve bottlenecks with early product partners and turn those solutions into reusable platform capabilities. Success means faster adoption while meeting model quality, latency, reliability, and cost targets.
You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…
Lead projects from customer problem through design, implementation, and rollout. Coordinate delivery across engineers, mentor peers, and help shape the team’s roadmap.
Improve inference performance through production traces, load tests, and CPU/GPU profiling. Work with model owners to balance model quality, tail latency, throughput, and cost.
Partner with Compute on capacity, placement, and scaling, accounting for request complexity, cache state, GPU memory, and model startup behavior.
Build self-serve APIs and deployment workflows that manage models, runtime dependencies, features, and versioned state, with validation, safe rollout, and rollback.
Evaluate, integrate, and extend open source tools and vendor capabilities that advance model serving. Decide when to build or adopt, and collaborate with maintainers and vendors.
Own production reliability through service objectives, observability, on-call, incident response, and follow-through. Reduce recurring operational work through automation.
We’re excited about you because…
You have 6+ years of software engineering experience designing, building, and operating production infrastructure or distributed systems.
You have hands-on experience serving large or complex neural models online, with accountability for latency, availability, and resource efficiency.
You bring strong distributed systems fundamentals and proficiency in a backend or systems language such as Python, Go, Java, Kotlin, or C++.
You understand inference tradeoffs across batching, concurrency, caching, memory, and CPU/GPU utilization, and can diagnose production bottlenecks.
You have operated services on Kubernetes or comparable infrastructure, including resource configuration, autoscaling, and failure recovery.
You’ve led substantial projects through ambiguity, partnered with fast-moving ML or product teams, and helped other engineers grow.
You hold a degree in Computer Science or a related field, or have equivalent practical experience.
Nice to Have
Experience integrating or extending inference tools such as Triton Inference Server or PyTorch.
Experience with multi-GPU inference, model parallelism, model-aware caching, or accelerator scheduling.
Experience building model workflows, deployment tooling, or instrumentation with Metaflow, Helm, or OpenTelemetry.
We value production serving depth and engineering judgment; experience with every technology is not required.

Join us at DoorDash, where our people are our most valuable asset. As a member of our Architecture and Security team, you’ll play an instrumental role in building simple experiences with technology. We’re looking for a talented Solutions Architect, Business Technology Security to join our team and work closely with our business partners to drive key business decisions and innovate in critical tools such as Workday and the custom tools and dashboards we build on top of it.
About the Role
The DoorDash Architecture and Security team is looking for a Solutions Architect, Business Technology Security with demonstrated experience and knowledge in Workday Security. This role owns the strategy and design of Workday security architecture, and ensures it translates correctly into the custom, in-house tools and dashboards built downstream of it. This is a strategy and design-focused role so success here depends heavily on your ability to gather clear requirements, write them up well, and communicate design decisions to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. You will interact directly with senior leaders and cross-functional partners across DoorDash to capture requirements and design lasting, secure solutions that hold up across the full ecosystem.

Translate that architecture into clear requirements and design documentation that our build team can implement, and that downstream custom tools and dashboards can be built against safely.

Partner with process owners to define data security policies, protocols, and procedures that protect sensitive HR data across Workday and downstream systems.
Conduct regular audits and risk assessments across Workday and the tools and reporting layers downstream of it, maintaining a forward-looking security and data classification roadmap.
Serve as the subject matter expert on security, data, and reporting capabilities and limitations, communicating trade-offs clearly to both build teams and non-technical business stakeholders.

You have 5-7 years of work experience in HRIS implementation and configuration, both domestic and international, with deep expertise in Workday Security.

title: Team Lead, Critical Investigations
description:
About the Team
DoorDash's Critical Investigations Team plays a critical role in ensuring the safety of our platform and the communities we serve. The team is responsible for investigating internal fraud cases to protect company assets and maintain the integrity of our operations. CIU operates in high-stakes, time-sensitive situations, requiring precision, discretion, and a deep understanding of legal and regulatory frameworks.
About the Role
The Critical Investigations Unit (CIU) Team Lead is a key position responsible for overseeing high-impact investigations and guiding specialized teams including our Law Enforcement Response Team. This role addresses the most sensitive, time-critical, and complex cases within the Trust & Safety organization. The ideal candidate will be an experienced investigator with extensive knowledge of law enforcement response, fraud detection, and critical incident triage. The CIU Team Lead will report directly to the CIU Supervisor.
At DoorDash, we believe in fostering a culture of meaningful connection, collaboration, and professional growth through in-office interactions. This position requires an in-office presence at the DoorDash corporate office in Tempe and the employee must live within a commutable 50 miles from the office. In-office days are determined by the business and can change based on business needs. Connect with the recruiter to determine what the in-office requirement for this role is.
This shift for this role is Monday–Friday, 6:00 AM–2:30 PM Arizona Time (MST). The schedule may be adjusted based on business needs.
Key Responsibilities
Lead High-Severity Investigations: Oversee the execution of Law Enforcement Response Team (LERT) exigent and investigative cases, ensuring swift and lawful responses to legal requests and critical safety escalations.
Team Oversight: Provide direct leadership and strategic guidance to investigators across the Law Enforcement Response Team (LERT) ensuring quality, consistency, and timeliness in case handling.
Case Management & Prioritization: Triage, assign, and monitor the progression of sensitive investigations across multiple workstreams, particularly those involving threats to life, public safety, or internal fraud.
Cross-Functional Partnership: Collaborate closely with Legal, Security, Global Security, and other internal stakeholders to drive outcomes in investigations, deliver insights, and influence policy improvements.
Process Improvement: Identify trends, gaps, and opportunities for automation or efficiency across investigative workflows; lead process updates and documentation initiatives.
Mentorship & Development: Support the professional growth of the Law Enforcement Response Team (LERT) through coaching, feedback, and knowledge sharing.
Rotational After-Hours Escalation Support: Participate in on-call rotations to ensure CIU responsiveness during emergencies outside standard business hours.
